description:
Tests define gates through `add_gate_definition`, a command method production never calls. It also builds automated gates without a checker, which the production path refuses.

## Background

`CommandExecutor::add_gate_definition` (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:1155-1191`) is reached only from tests: the harness wrapper `add_gate` (`src/test_harness.rs:209-220`) and direct calls in `tests/fast_docs_templates/planning_preset_tests.rs:36`, `template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs:399` and `template_apply_tests.rs:955`.

The harness wrapper's callers are `tests/fast_issue/bulk_operations_tests.rs` (12 calls), `tests/fast_docs_templates/harness_demo.rs` (3), `tests/fast_docs_templates/batch_export_tests.rs` (2), `tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_tests.rs` (2) and `tests/fast_issue/test_no_coordinator.rs` (1).

The production definition path is `CommandExecutor::define_gate` (`gate.rs:1203-1250`), reached from `gate define`. It rejects an automated gate without a checker (`gate.rs:1222-1226`). Four test sites build that invalid gate through `add_gate_definition` with `auto = true` (`template_apply_tests.rs:119,704,955`, `template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs:399`). `GateChecker::RepositoryValidation` is the natural checker for them. The other callers pass `auto = false`, which maps to a manual gate with no checker.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CommandExecutor::add_gate_definition` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared test harness's gate helper delegates to `define_gate` and takes a mode and an optional checker.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests that built an automated gate without a checker define it with the repository-validation checker.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each affected test keeps the property it asserted.

## Notes

A shared gate-definition fixture is optional; if one is added, it lives in the shared test support.
title: Define test gates through the production definition path
